description.value: You can overclock a wider variety of gear. When you take this feat, select one programming language other than your own. You gain the overclock boost benefits of that programming language, meaning you can select that type of gear when you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Overclock Gear] instead of the type normally allowed by your original programming language. You don't gain the firmware enhancement, Overclock Pulse, or other benefits of that programming language.
